name: My-Cloud
description: My Cloud is a lightweight file sharing platform in the spirit of Nextcloud/ownCloud, but with zero database setup. Multi-user accounts, a fast web file browser with previews, drag-and-drop uploads, public share links with passwords and expiry, a trash bin, and quotas - all stored as simple JSON files. Perfect for home users who don't have a ton of files and don't want to babysit a database.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: App settings, users and share links (small JSON files)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns created files (Unraid default: 99 = nobody)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns created files (Unraid default: 100 = users)
